parameters.content:
## Demo: failure reporter
The other two workflows name this one as their **error workflow**. If a run stops outright (the directory is down, the sheet cannot be read), n8n starts this and it writes a line to the Failures tab.

Failures on a single event (a broken photo, a refused post) are logged inside the main workflows so the other events carry on.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ event: "(whole run)", step: $json.execution?.lastNodeExecuted ?? "Trigger", error: $json.execution?.error?.message ?? $json.trigger?.error?.message ?? "Unknown error", workflow: $json.workflow?.name ?? "" }) }}

meta.note: Demo. Runs against local stand-ins on 127.0.0.1:8787 with made-up events. Nothing is posted anywhere real.
